backend.gpu: Salted leaf hashing and Merkle compression only
backend.cpu: Strict verification, DFT, quotient evaluation, opening reductions and FRI arithmetic

watchdog_fault_tests.note: Initial test found systemd SIGTERM may be a successful service stop. Monitor checks now guard both sides of each stage; all three corrected tests passed.

requirement_audit.candidate_only_opt_in_cpu_default: PASS: gpu compilation alone does not select acceleration; no production ABI added.
requirement_audit.hash_only_unchanged_security_profile: PASS: only salted leaf hashing/Merkle compression accelerated; cubic q128/blowup16/cap6 unchanged.
requirement_audit.strict_cpu_verifier_and_encoding: PASS: 122 same-seed commitment comparisons, real cubic proof cross-verification, five recursive roots.
requirement_audit.independent_registry_pin: PASS: accelerated registered caps and expected statement match the CPU baseline byte for byte.
requirement_audit.fresh_proof_randomness_public_only_input: PASS: fresh CSPRNG-backed proof configurations; public fixtures only; five distinct root hashes. Not a zero-knowledge proof.
requirement_audit.single_engine_and_process_serialization: PASS: one mutex-protected context; second-process lease rejection tested before job creation; serial proving services.
requirement_audit.managed_allocation_bounds_and_release: PASS: checked aggregate/per-allocation admission and replacement; all full-size shutdowns returned zero managed bytes.
requirement_audit.physical_vram_limit: NOT A HARD QUOTA: 8 GiB managed ceiling plus 4 GiB reserve and sampled 12 GiB abort threshold; instantaneous physical peaks not certified.
requirement_audit.observed_ram_spill_and_swap: PASS: proving/controller caps enforced; all measured services zero swap; peak mapped spill below 120 GiB.
requirement_audit.watchdog_fail_closed: PASS after correction: all three fault injections stop the job without starting a later stage.
requirement_audit.repeated_full_strength_trial_and_pruning: PASS: 35 recursive proofs, all envelopes <=2 MiB; ten inner files removed per job; shared wallets removed; all five roots replayed on CPU.
requirement_audit.profiling_and_transfer_evidence: PASS: per-node deltas and inclusive spans captured, no witness values logged; no dropped/open spans at checkpoints.
requirement_audit.final_regressions: PASS: streaming/GPU/non-streaming/auditor tests, all-feature build, Rust/Zig formatting, shell syntax, Zig Debug/ReleaseSafe/FFI and default ABI isolation.
requirement_audit.production_qualification: NOT IN SCOPE / NOT PASSED: depth-six, padding, security review, incremental deadlines and network activation remain open.

post_change_regression.streaming_ignored_explanation: Two standalone wide-resource tests plus two GPU tests; the latter both passed in the separate explicit GPU run.

caveats: Four transactions and two merge levels, not the 64-transaction/depth-six or incremental-deadline qualification.
RAM peaks are per proving-service cgroups; controller is separately bounded. Mapped spill is live storage, not additional RAM.
VRAM monitoring is sampled and cannot establish an instantaneous physical-driver allocation quota; other applications/users are outside the cooperative lease.
Profiling spans are inclusive/non-additive. GPU counters are cumulative within each process; node deltas are reported separately.
Wallet proving and initial registry creation are excluded from recursive command totals.
The runtime binaries remain fixed. The reusable launcher and monitor stage guards were added after trial 1; no proving arithmetic was changed.
